correctness.rationale: The exact graph and forbidden 3-vertex-path criterion are specified. A standalone exhaustive checker generates 6,812 faces and all 35,104 Hasse covers; its 3,400-pair element matching has a complete acyclic directed topological ordering and 12 critical cells. It constructs exact signed integral Morse matrices D5=[[-1,0,-1,-1]] and D6 of size 4×6, verifies D5D6=0, cancels a degree −1 4/5-cell CW subcomplex and identifies a 3×3 unit determinant in the remaining degree-six attaching matrix. The residual 5-skeleton is wedge of three S5, Hurewicz computes attaching maps exactly, and unimodular basis changes produce the wedge of three S6. Independent mod-two original simplex-chain rank calculation corroborates but is not substituted for integral proof.

value.rationale: The Möbius–Kantor graph is a canonical, highly symmetric 16-vertex nonchordal cubic incidence graph. Its first higher-independence complex is an intrinsically motivated finite homotopy classification outside tree/chordal methods; the seven-dimensional combinatorial complex has exact integral homotopy wedge of three six-spheres. The certificate resolves attaching maps integrally, rather than merely computing ranks. The fact is a reusable precise benchmark for graph-complex topology, while no general family result or unsupported consequences are claimed.
